policy.bundled: Only components with a redistributable license are copied into literature/vendor; their original LICENSE files are retained.
policy.local_adapter: Components without a verified redistributable license are not copied. The router detects them under the user's Codex skills directory and invokes them in place.
policy.core_first: The scripts in scripts/ remain the fallback and the only required execution path.

skills.name: nature-downloader
skills.capability: Authorized institutional PDF download through the user's logged-in Chrome session

skills.name: organize-research-literature
skills.capability: Recursive inventory and deep review of a local PDF corpus into an Excel workbook
skills.fallback: Use a supplied PDF list or the core passage/screenshot scripts directly

skills.name: nature-academic-search
skills.capability: Broader multi-source search, citation verification, MeSH strategy, and citation-file conversion through MCP tools
skills.license: Apache-2.0 upstream; installed copy may omit a LICENSE file

skills.name: nature-reader
skills.capability: Full-paper Chinese-English, figure/table-aware reading and translation
skills.license: Apache-2.0 upstream; installed copy may omit a LICENSE file
skills.fallback: scripts/locate_passage.py for the evidence passage only

skills.name: nature-citation
skills.capability: Segment manuscript text, find Nature/CNS-family support, and export reference-manager files
skills.license: Apache-2.0 upstream; installed copy may omit a LICENSE file

skills.name: nature-literature-pipeline
skills.capability: Recurring literature discovery, scoring, digest delivery, and archival
skills.license: Apache-2.0 upstream repository; installed SKILL.md declares MIT
skills.fallback: Run scripts/find_papers.py manually on a schedule

skills.name: literature-mapper
skills.capability: arXiv + OpenAlex scoping and abstract-level literature mapping with journal/CCF filters
skills.license: Custom non-commercial license in the installed README; not bundled
skills.upstream: Installed local copy; see its README for the author's terms

skills.name: zotero-taxonomy-curator
skills.capability: Zotero evidence extraction, controlled taxonomy mapping, and Obsidian close-reading notes
skills.license: No license file found in the installed copy; not bundled
skills.upstream: Installed local copy; inspect its source terms before redistribution
skills.fallback: Extract the relevant page with scripts/locate_passage.py and keep notes outside the evidence report
